implementation: Portable readable C99 finite packed-decimal preparation and xorshift32; no firmware execution, CPU model, host RNG or floating point

implemented_routines.name: xorshift32
implemented_routines.scope: All uint32_t states, shifts13/17/5 with four-byte XOR feedback

implemented_routines.name: Ran#
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared normal and unchecked decimal seed records; old raw exponent-byte addend, mantissa selection, finite scaling, four-byte conversion, full fraction seed commit and three-place output

implemented_routines.name: positive fractional mantissa selection
implemented_routines.scope: Replace external exponent/sign bytes with99/00 without changing mantissa

implemented_routines.name: floor
implemented_routines.scope: Integral truncation then subtractone only for changed negative ordinary scalar results; malformed mantissa nibbles are retained

implemented_routines.name: RanInt#
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared lower/upper scalar admission, CAA8 ten-digit integral gates on both bounds and span, strict positive span, widthplusone, full seed scaling and floor

implemented_routines.name: decimal to four-byte unsigned integer
implemented_routines.scope: Three finite decimal divmod steps with256 and fourth high-byte extraction

implemented_routines.name: four-byte unsigned integer to decimal
implemented_routines.scope: Exact reconstruction over the complete uint32_t domain

gaps: Forged raw8x compact-surd seed headers, which are unreachable from the verified reset/idle/Ran# lifecycle, remain explicitly UNIMPLEMENTED; their complete original outcomes are retained in the native fixture corpus
Malformed compact-surd bound components rejected by the separately verified numeric foundation remain explicitly UNIMPLEMENTED
Existing raw decimal helpers identify proven native magnitude-ordering nonreturns with UNIMPLEMENTED, leaving output untouched
Raw8C/C2 expression grammar, random seed binding to user RAM and UI/controller scheduling are separate integration work
The prepared API exports value, persistent seed and native status; unused CPU/decimal scratch is outside that value API
